tasks_completed.changes: Added sanitizeMermaidTimeline() that: (1) detects timeline diagrams by /^timeline\b/i, (2) strips all non-ASCII characters (CJK, Arabic, etc.) from each line, (3) removes empty event entries (lines matching /^\s*:\s*$/). Applied before mermaid.render() in renderMermaidSvg().
tasks_completed.rationale: mermaid timeline parser throws on non-ASCII characters. Root cause: commit f8b208fa introduced MermaidRenderer without timeline-specific sanitization.

tasks_completed.description: Replaced raw source error fallback with user-friendly MermaidErrorFallback component
tasks_completed.changes: MermaidErrorFallback now shows 'Timeline diagram could not be rendered' text only. Removed the codeBlock and codeText style usage (code block with raw source). The errorContainer and errorContent styles are preserved.
tasks_completed.rationale: Showing raw Mermaid source to users is hostile UX. AC3 requires a friendly message.

tasks_completed.description: Refactored MermaidRenderer to satisfy quality gate (function length <= 30, nesting depth <= 3)
tasks_completed.changes: Extracted: buildMermaidThemeVars(), buildWebContainerStyle(), renderMermaidSvg(), MermaidWebRenderer(), MermaidLoadingPlaceholder(), MermaidErrorFallback(), updateHeight(), buildNativeHtml(). The existing file had violations (if-block 85 lines, depth 7) that blocked the quality gate from allowing any edits.
tasks_completed.rationale: Quality gate hook blocked writes due to pre-existing violations in the original file structure.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: f8b208fa - feat: F1 LaTeX/Mermaid + F2 image upload (introduced MermaidRenderer)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: MermaidRenderer was built for general Mermaid support without timeline-specific sanitization. mermaid v11 timeline parser has known Unicode parsing issues.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: sanitizeMermaidTimeline() strips non-ASCII before render. Only applied to timeline type to avoid affecting other working diagram types.

dev.qa_notes: Test with: (1) A timeline diagram with Chinese characters — should render as SVG. (2) A timeline diagram with empty events (lines like '  : ') — should render after stripping. (3) A flowchart with Unicode — should be unaffected (sanitizer skips non-timeline). (4) Error fallback — should show 'Timeline diagram could not be rendered' not raw source. The only importer is MarkdownView.tsx so QA should test any message that renders markdown with a Mermaid block.

recommendations: The codeBlock and codeText stylesheet entries can be removed in a follow-up cleanup since MermaidErrorFallback no longer uses them.
Consider adding a similar sanitizer for other CJK-heavy diagram types if users report issues with pie charts or gantt diagrams in future.
